name: Work-Centrism vs. Life Balance/Skepticism
questions: Do you agree that being a housewife is just as fulfilling as working for pay?
Do you agree that people who don't work turn lazy?
Do you agree that work is a duty towards society?
Do you agree that work should always come first, even if it means less spare time?
If less importance were placed on work in our lives, would you think it would be a good thing, a bad thing, or don't you mind?

Do you agree with the statement1 'In the long run, hard work usually brings a better life' or the statement2 'Hard work doesn't generally bring success—it's more a matter of luck and connections'? Using this card on which 1 means you agree completely with the 'statement1' and 10 means you agree completely with the 'statement2'

name: Open Democratic Governance vs. Authoritarian Control
questions: How often do you think ordinary people have to pay a bribe, give a gift, or do a favor to local officials and service providers in order to get the services you need: never, rarely, frequently, or always?

How would you rate the risk of being held accountable for giving or receiving a bribe, gift, or favor in return for public service in this country on a scale from '1' meaning 'no risk at all' to '10' meaning 'very high risk'?
Do you think your country's government should or should not have the right to keep people under video surveillance in public areas?
Do you think your country's government should or should not have the right to monitor all e-mails and any other information exchanged on the Internet?
Do you think your country's government should or should not have the right to collect information about anyone living in this country without their knowledge?
How important is having honest elections for you: very important, rather important, not very important, or not at all important?
How much do you think the political system in your country allows people like you to have a say in what the government does: a great deal, a lot, some, very little, or not at all?
How do you feel about having a strong leader who does not have to bother with parliament and elections as a way of governing this country?
How do you feel about having the army rule as a way of governing this country?
How do you feel about having a democratic political system as a way of governing this country?
How do you feel about having a system governed by religious law in which there are no political parties or elections as a way of governing this country?

How essential do you think it is for democracy that people choose their leaders in free elections? Using this card on which 0 means 'it is against democracy', 1 means 'not at all an essential characteristic of democracy' and 10 means 'an essential characteristic of democracy'

How essential do you think it is for democracy that the army takes over when government is incompetent? Using this card on which 0 means 'it is against democracy', 1 means 'not at all an essential characteristic of democracy' and 10 means 'an essential characteristic of democracy'

How essential do you think it is for democracy that civil rights protect people from state oppression? Using this card on which 0 means 'it is against democracy', 1 means 'not at all an essential characteristic of democracy' and 10 means 'an essential characteristic of democracy'

How essential do you think it is for democracy that people obey their rulers? Using this card on which 0 means 'it is against democracy', 1 means 'not at all an essential characteristic of democracy' and 10 means 'an essential characteristic of democracy'
How important is it for you to live in a country that is governed democratically? Using this card on which 1 means 'not at all important' and 10 means 'absolutely important'

name: Open Multiculturalism vs. Nativism
questions: Would you not like to have immigrants or foreign workers as neighbors?
Do you agree that when jobs are scarce, employers should give priority to people of this country over immigrants?
What does the government should do about people from other countries coming here to work?

name: Traditional Family & Intergenerational Duty vs. Modern Individualism
questions: Do you consider hard work to be especially important for children to learn at home?
Do you consider a feeling of responsibility to be especially important for children to learn at home?
Do you consider religious faith to be especially important for children to learn at home?
Do you consider obedience to be especially important for children to learn at home?
Do you agree that one of your main goals in life has been to make your parents proud?
Do you agree that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer?
Do you agree that it is a duty towards society to have children?
Do you agree that adult children have the duty to provide long-term care for their parents?

name: Traditional Gender Roles vs. Gender Egalitarianism
questions: Do you agree that on the whole, men make better political leaders than women do?
Do you agree that a university education is more important for a boy than for a girl?
Do you agree that on the whole, men make better business executives than women do?
Do you agree that when jobs are scarce, men should have more right to a job than women?
Do you agree that if a woman earns more money than her husband, it's almost certain to cause problems?
How strongly do you agree or disagree with the statement 'on the whole, women are less corrupt than men', or do you find it hard to say?
How often do women have equal opportunities to run for office in this country's elections?

How essential do you think it is for democracy that women have the same rights as men? Using this card on which 0 means 'it is against democracy', 1 means 'not at all an essential characteristic of democracy' and 10 means 'an essential characteristic of democracy'

name: Positive vs. Negative Perception of Immigration's Impact
questions: How would you evaluate the impact of immigrants on the development of your country?
Do you agree that immigration strengthens cultural diversity?
Do you agree that immigration increases the crime rate?
Do you agree that immigration increases the risks of terrorism?
Do you agree that immigration offers people from poor countries a better living?
Do you agree that immigration increases unemployment?
Do you agree that immigration leads to social conflict?

name: Religious Absolutism vs. Modern Secular Rationality
questions: Would you not like to have people of a different religion as neighbors?
How much do you trust people of another religion: completely, somewhat, not very much, or not at all?
Do you agree that we depend too much on science and not enough on faith? Using this card on which 1 means you 'completely disagree' and 10 means you 'completely agree'
Do you believe in God?
Do you strongly agree, agree, disagree, or strongly disagree that whenever science and religion conflict, religion is always right?
Do you strongly agree, agree, disagree, or strongly disagree that the only acceptable religion is your religion?

How essential do you think it is for democracy that religious authorities ultimately interpret the laws? Using this card on which 0 means 'it is against democracy', 1 means 'not at all an essential characteristic of democracy' and 10 means 'an essential characteristic of democracy'

name: Personal Freedom of Choice vs. Traditional Social Morality
questions: Would you not like to have homosexuals as neighbors?
Would you not like to have unmarried couples living together as neighbors?
Do you agree that homosexual couples are as good parents as other couples?
Do you think the homosexuality can always be justified, never be justified, or something in between? Using this card on which 1 means 'Never justifiable' and 10 means 'Always justifiable'
Do you think the prostitution can always be justified, never be justified, or something in between? Using this card on which 1 means 'Never justifiable' and 10 means 'Always justifiable'
Do you think the sex before marriage can always be justified, never be justified, or something in between? Using this card on which 1 means 'Never justifiable' and 10 means 'Always justifiable'
Do you think that having casual sex can always be justified, never be justified, or something in between? Using this card on which 1 means 'Never justifiable' and 10 means 'Always justifiable'
